provenance.notes: Source-faithful four-panel Conquer architecture. Native source paths and typeable ordinary labels are retained. Source Cambria Math remains editable glyph outlines. The bitmap SAG/skill-library panel is rebuilt from measured source coordinates as native boxes, arrows, labels and formula contours, retaining only isolated flame/snowflake icons and glow effects. No full-figure or full-panel raster backdrop is embedded.
provenance.extraction_review: Source pixels and final generated PNG inspected; isolated images and rotated text reviewed; independent editor QA pending.
provenance.font_substitutions: Times New Roman ordinary labels with source weight/italic retained. Reconstructed SAG labels use source-measured Times New Roman sizing.
provenance.outlined_math_limit: Selected source mathematical fonts preserved as editable glyph outlines, not live equation/text objects.
provenance.dash_fidelity: Source custom dash patterns expanded as native solid path segments; no Office dash preset approximation remains in this figure.

provenance.editor_fixes: Eight reviewed black open shaft/head compounds split to avoid even-odd cutouts. Original individual gradient-arrow pixels precomposed over their verified uniform #F2F2F2 surface while retaining transparent exterior.
provenance.text_editability: Ordinary source captions/labels and reconstructed SAG labels are native typeable text; Timeline is native rotated text. Cambria Math and reconstructed SAG math remain editable glyph paths, not live equations.
provenance.raster_panel_reconstruction: Source bitmap instance 38 is not embedded. Its SAG architecture is rebuilt with native shapes/arrows/labels and source mathematical contours. Only flame/snowflake icons and two text-free glow rings are isolated raster insets.
extraction_warnings_reviewed: All selected source images/shadings isolated with original source SVG clips and masks. Literal letter-M shadow omitted so editing the native instruction does not expose old lettering. SAG bitmap replaced with native objects and isolated icons/glow rings. Rotated ordinary Timeline label restored as native text.
